proof_summary: Modular exponentiation, together with \(28341=3^2\cdot47\cdot67\), shows that \(28341\) has exact order \(28341\) modulo the prime \(283411\), so every cyclotomic factor indexed by a proper divisor of \(28341\) is nonzero modulo \(283411\) and hence a unit modulo \(283411^2\). A further modular exponentiation gives \(28341^{28341}=1\pmod{283411^2}\); factoring \(x^{28341}-1\) into cyclotomic factors and cancelling the proper-divisor factors forces the remaining cyclotomic factor to vanish modulo \(283411^2\).
